# moodle_enrolled_user (Data Source)

Fetches a list of enrolled Moodle users for a specific course.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "moodle_enrolled_user" "course_participants" {
  course_id = moodle_course.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `course_id` (Number) The ID of the course to fetch users for.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `course_id` (Number) The ID of the course.
- `id` (String) ID of the enrolment (composite key).
- `role_ids` (List of Number) The IDs of the roles.
- `user_email` (String) The mail address of the user.
